channel.title: Homes Under the Hammer
channel.desc: Jacqui catches up with an ambitious project to develop five luxury flats in Crystal Palace, while Martel follows a quirky lot with bags of potential in Stoke, and Tommy talks to a full-time teacher who has the vision to create a lovely family home in Bexleyheath, combining a modern feel while retaining lovely period features.
